Commentary.Commentary: So, that's it from us, then! Pakistan have won the 3-match series as they currently lead 2-0. West Indies haven't had a good tour here at all as they've not managed to win a single match. Maybe they can save some face in the last and final ODI in the Gulf. It takes place on 5th October at Abu Dhabi at 1630 IST. We hope you join us for it. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Pakistan skipper, AZHAR ALI thanks the Almighty for today's win and says after losing two early wickets, Shoaib Malik and Babar Azam played an intelligent innings and asessed the conditions really well. Says the whole of the team is fired up as they know they have to win each and every game. Adds that the team is improving day by day and today the batsmen as well as the fast bowlers stepped up. Mentions that it is difficult for the fast bowlers to bowl long spells, making it a difficult task for him. He adds by saying that if they would have held those dropped catches it would have been a perfect game for them and says that they have been working hard on their field which helped them in today's crucial run outs. On his personal form, he says that he is timing it well in the nets but he is not able to get that timing out in the middle but hopes to do so in the next match.

West Indies skipper, JASON HOLDER says it was not a great performance by his team. Also says they should have hit more boundaries than what they did in the chase. Adds that the conditions were difficult out there and one needed to settle in to launch the big shots. Praises Wahab Riaz and Mohammad Amir for their bowling. Ends by saying that they will have to start fresh for their final ODI in Abu Dhabi and not think about this game.

Man of the Match, BABAR AZAM says he wanted to play the full quota of 50 overs and wanted to fulfill what his coach demanded from him. He says one big partnership was needed and Shoaib Malik took the pressure off him by taking the charge in the partnership. Ends by thanking the Almighty for blessing him with such talent.

The Pakistan bowlers were terrific on the whole. They kept the runs tight and made sure the run rate was never within reach of the Windies. They had a mixed time out in the field. Got the run outs but dropped a lot of catches. Amir and Wasim picked up a scalp each but it was Wahab Riaz who was the standout bowler. He came in and bowled his heart out. Was fierce and terrorized the opposition. He picked up 2 wickets and was phenomenal. Earlier in the day, a powerful ton from Babar Azam and electric fifties from Shoaib Malik and Sarfraz Ahmed saw Pakistan post a total in excess of 330, which proved too much for the West Indies.

Samuels then carried on with Ramdin and the duo made 67 runs between them. Samuels, who was dropped thrice, finally ran out of luck and got bowled once again by Wahab Riaz. Despite the multiple reprieves given to him, he couldn't inflict any real damage. The run rate kept creeping up on the visiting side and there was no way back for them.

A blazing start was needed for the Windies to have any chance of winning this contest. That never came to be as Charles was lost early. Kraigg Brathwaite and Darren Bravo then steadied the ship. They started off cautiously but then picked the pace up. Both were dismissed eventually but not before they stitched a 89-run partnership. The southpaw completed his fifty but he was given a life by the Pakistan skipper earlier in his innings.

Another comfortable win for Pakistan and they've done so with style and authority. The Men in Green now have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead and are on the up from hereon. With a target of 338 to chase, it was going to take something special for West Indies to win this one. Nothing of that sort was produced and they lost horribly.
Full around off, Narine charges down and swings the bat hard but misses and the ball goes off his pads towards the short third man fielder. PAKISTAN WIN THE MATCH BY 59 RUNS!
Outside off, steered through cover-point for a single.
Sliding it into the pads, flicked away on the leg side for a single.

DROPPED! Full outside leg, Narine gets down on one knee and slogs it uppishly through mid-wicket. The fielder at short mid-wicket dives at full stretch to his left to take the catch. Gets his hands to it but is unable to hold onto it. That's the 6th catch dropped in the field by Pakistan.
Wide! Down the leg side, Narine leaves it watchfully. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Served on middle and leg, defended towards the mid off region.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ to bowl the final over of the match.
Narine stays in his crease and blocks it in front of covers.
Darts this one outside off, Narine pushes it to covers.
Jason Holder works this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SUNIL NARINE walks in next!

OUT! Pollard's been finally put out of his misery. Fuller and flatter outside off, Pollard just throws his bat at this. Gets a thick, thick top edge which skies towards wide long off. Shoaib Malik is the man there. He comes under it and comfortably takes it, showing everyone how it's done. Another wicket down for West Indies.
Flighted delivery outside off, drilled to wide long off for a single.

DROPPED! Another one! Well, this is one area where Pakistan will feel they have let themselves down. Fuller ball around off, Pollard slogs this one down towards long on. Nawaz comes running in and dives forward to take it but drops it. Should have taken it really. A single is taken.
IMAD WASIM will bowl the penultimate over.
Excellent length ball aiming the top of off stump, sturdily kept out from within the crease. End of the over.
On a length and around off, Pollard makes good use of his wrists and whips it through the mid-wicket region for another single.
Fullish in length and homing in on middle and leg, it's worked through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched marginally fuller this time, still attacking the stumps here, Holder gets behind the line and keeps it out with a solid straight bat.
Length ball on the stumps, it's eased down to mid on for one.

FOUR! That will run away. Fuller length ball outside off, Pollard steps out to this one and gets an outside edge as he pushes it away from his body. Runs past the short third man fielder and away to the fence behind.
Slower one from Wahab, bowls it on a length and well outside off, Jason Holder with an open face dabs it towards point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kieron Pollard drags the pull through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short of a length and around off, angling in, it's tapped down into the track in front.
Length ball pitched outside off, it's played square of the wicket towards point for an easy run.
FOUR! Nicely done. Straying on the pads, Holder gets back and clips it down towards and across the fine leg fence to get a boundary to his name.
Supreme pace from Wahab Riaz once more. He comes steaming in, and fires it in full at 142 kph, outside off and beats the outside edge of Jason Holder's bat.
Pitched just back of a length, coming in to the rib cage, it's kept out off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, it's driven towards extra cover for a single.

FOUR! ALMOST A CATCH! That seemed like it was planned. Amir bangs it in short and gets it to angle in to the batsman. Holder stays back and pulls it just over the man at short fine leg. The fielder there rises in an attempt to take it but just misses. Was very close.
Short and sharp again, Kieron nudges it behind square on the leg side for one run.
Short of a length delivery angling in, it goes off the splice and lobs towards short leg. Amir runs to it to try and take but it falls well short of him.
Amir comes charging in from around the wicket, angles in a length ball on the pads, the WI skipper defends it on the on side and scampers to the other end to complete a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl from the other end.
A slower back of a length delivery outside off, Jason Holder once again opens the face and taps it in front of short third man for a quick single. WI need 87 more runs to win off 30 deliveries.
FOUR! Low full toss outside off, Holder lunges forward, opens the face of the bat and drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Angling in on the pads, Kieron turns it through square leg for one more run.
Pitched slightly fuller of a length and around off, Jason Holder pushes it through the covers for a single.
Excellent change of pace. Bowls a slower one, on a length and around off, Holder once again backs away to hit it through the off side but misses yet again.
Wahab comes charging in from around the wicket, fires it in full and outside off, Holder backs away in an attempt to smash this through the covers but fails to put any bat on it.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Wasim darts it in on middle and leg, Holder mistimes the pull to mid-wicket for two runs.
Driven down to long on for an easy single.
Quicker one pushed through well outside off, Pollard looks to go big but ends up miscuing it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Darted in on the stumps, it's hit down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Fuller and flatter outside off, Holder stands his ground and hammers this through the covers to pick up a boundary.
IMAD WASIM is back on.
Slower short delivery this time, Pollard looks to hook it but is done by the lack of pace. Good variation by Wahab! What a gala time he is having out there in the middle.
Quicker short delivery, Pollard looks to pull but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off, Holder has a poke at it and is beaten by the pace.
Length delivery outside off, played with soft hands on the leg side for a single.
JASON HOLDER walks in next.

OUT! WAHAB WITH A BEAUTY IN FIELD! Length delivery outside off, Pollard looks to pull but only manages to bottom edge it near the silly mid off region. Wahab charges towards the ball, picks up, turns and fires in a throw in a single breath and also is successful in hitting the stumps. Brathwaite, who is out of his crease is trying hard to get back. The umpire refers this upstairs. The replays shows that Brathwaite is well out and has to walk back. This is the second time in the match, a bowler has made a run out on his follow through. Wahab making his presence felt everywhere. 6 wickets down, WI are in a big, big trouble. PAKISTAN NEED 4 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
A run out decision against Carlos Brathwaite is referred upstairs.
WAHAB RIAZ will have a change of ends.
SWING AND A MISS AGAIN! Pitched wide outside off, Brathwaite again goes for a wild swing but misses again. Pace bowlers doing the trick for Pakistan this time!
Shortish delivery, mistimed pull earns Carlos a couple of runs through square leg.
SWING AND A MISS! Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite goes for a big golf-like swing but fails to connect. The ball just sails over the top of off stump and Brathwaite is releived to see that.
FOUR! EDGED BUT RACED AWAY! Full toss outside off, Carlos goes for a big heave but doesn't time it well. The ball goes off the outside edge of his bat for a boundary through the third man region.
Angling down leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Leg bye! Angling into the pads, CB looks to tuck it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball then goes towards the square leg region, batsmen scrap through for one leg bye.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back into the bowling attack.
Length delivery outside off, slapped through covers for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. They pick up a single.
Full on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Pitched outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Full around off, Brathwaite brings his bat down just in time and gets an inside edge past the stumps. The bastmen scrapes through for a quick single.
Length delivery, angling in, Pollard works it for a single through square leg.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Angling into the pads, tucked off the pad for a single.
FOUR! SWUNG HARD! Shortish delivery outside off, Brathwaite swings his bat hard and puts the ball over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Wide! Once more angling down leg, Brathwaite shuffles a touch, looking to work it on the leg side but fails to connect and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Wide! Angling down leg, CB leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE comes in next!

DRAGGED ON! WAHAB WITH GOLD AGAIN! Length delivery outside off, angling in, Ramdin in search of some quick runs, swings his bat hard but is undone by the pace of Wahab. The ball catches the inside edge of his bat and thuds into the leg stump. Ramdin had no option but to go after every delivery to match up with the asking run rate. However, Wahab's pacy spell has done the trick for Pakistan. Cometh the hour, cometh the man.

Leg bye! Angling in sharply at 148 kph, Pollard looks to work it with the angle but misses and hits him on the thigh pad. The ball runs through to backward square leg and the bastmen pick up one leg bye.

SIX! THAT'S A MONSTORUS HIT FROM THE LITTLE MAN! Wow! Where did he generate all that power from? Fuller and outside off, Ramdin stands his ground and swings his bat with everything he's got. Slogs it high and mighty over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen. The Caribbeans need more of these, a lot of more of these.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Pollard picks it off his pads and clips it down towards backward square leg for a run.
Yorker fired in on mdidle and off, Denesh digs it out to the off side. A single is taken. Good delivery.

Hasan Ali with a back of a length delivery around off, Pollard gets big on the ball and pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen think of taking the second but then settle for just the one. The 200 comes up for West Indies.
Short and on the body, Denesh Ramdin half-pulls this down towards short fine leg for a single.
Leg bye! Length ball angling in to the batsman, raps him on the thigh pad as he tries to play at it. Take a leg bye as well.
Again a fast-paced delivery, angling in, Pollard nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single. He is off the mark with that.
Pitched on a length outside off, taped to point. Pollard wants a run but Ramdin isn't interested in it.
Length delivery, angling in, worked through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, Pollard looks to tuck it but misses and goes off his thigh pads towards the backward square leg region for one leg bye.
KIERON POLLARD is the next man in to bat.

OUT! BOWLED' EM! Wahab bowls a length ball around off, Samuels looks to defend from within the crease but the low bounce makes it further more difficult and the ball goes onto the stumps off an inside edge. Samuels' luck finally runs out and Wahab bowls him out in successive matches. His pace does the trick and brings the crowd alive again.

DROPPED FOR THE 3RD TIME! Angling into the the batsman, Samuels looks to make room for himslef but is cramped by the delivery angling in. The ball catches the inside edge of the bat on its way but is dropped by Sarfraz behind the stumps who dives to his left in an attempt to take it. Wahab is furious with him!
FOUR! Another boundary! Good over for the West Indies. Low full toss on off, Ramdin gets low to this one and slogs it over the mid-wicket region to end the over with a boundary. 11 runs off the over.
Full ball on the stumps, driven down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Samuels picks up the change of pace and dispatches this away. A back-of-the-hand delivery around off, Samuels backs away and crashes it over the cover region to send it all the way.
Tight line from Hasan Ali, cramps Marlon Samuels for room as he looks to go big over the mid-wicket region. Dot ball.
Fired in full and outside off, Ramdin drills it to extra cover and takes a brisk run.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, it's hit down to long on for a single.
HASAN ALI is back into the attack!
Slower one from Wahab Riaz, on a length and outside off, Marlon waits for it and guides it down to third man for a single.

Some serious pace from Wahab! Comes running in hard and bangs in a back of a length delivery on middle and off, Ramdin is undone by the pace as he makes room to slap it away. Ends up miscuing it back down the track for one run.
Driven towards the mid off region. Two runs added to the total.
Full outside off, Ramdin lofts it over extra cover and picks up two runs.
28th ODI fifty for Marlon Samuels!
On a good length and around off, Marlon Samuels taps it to the off side and takes a quick single. Completes his fifty with that.
Wahab comes steaming in from around the wicket, bowls a length ball around off and gets it to angle in, Samuels makes room and slaps it through the covers for a couple.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Short again, this time it has been pulled on the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut to covers, where Asad does well to stop and give away no runs.
Shortish delivery, smashed on one bounce to long on for a single.
Full outside off, driven powerfully to covers, where Azhar Ali makes a good stop and keeps it down to one.
RAMDIN SURVIVES AGAIN! Served outside off, Ramdin charges down and swings his bat. The ball catches the inside edge of the bat and runs down to the fine leg fence. Ramdin picks up a couple of runs.
ALMOST DRAGGED ON! Full outside off, Ramdin goes for an expansive drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes past the off stump and runs towards the fine leg fence. The batsmen pick up a single.
Shortish delivery, angling across, pulled into the ground to mid-wicket.
Angling away from the batsman, he cuts it through the point region for a single.
Length delivery on the pads, tucked off the thigh pad, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Angling away from Ramdin, he looks to slap it but gets done by the pace. It was bowled over 150 kph by Wahab.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to covers.
WAHAB RIAZ is back into the attack.

SIX! DROPPED AND SENT INTO STANDS! Served around off, in Samuels' arc, he kneels down and slogs it but doesn't time it well. The ball goes high in the sky, Rizwan places himself under the ball but is confused as to where is the boundary rope. This double mind costs him as he drops the ball over the boundary rope for a maximum.
Served around leg, Ramdin gets down on one knee and sweeps it through fine leg for a single.
Shortish and quicker outside off, worked through cover-point for a single.
SIX! INTO THE STANDS! Served fuller around off, Samuels stretches his arms and swings his bat and connects the ball sweetly. The ball gets delivered straight into the stands over long on.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Slding down leg with the arm, tucked on the leg side behind square for a single.
IMAD WASIM returns.
Sliding away, Samuels looks to cut it but is done by the low bounce over there.

IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE! Tossed up around off, Samuels kneels down and slogs it but doesn't time it well. The ball geos off the top edge but fall safely at deep mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Pitched up outside off, driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! Full on middle and leg, Samuels hits it hard over mid-wicket and finds the gap in the deep and goes through to the boundary.
Served on off, spinning away, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, slapped to point.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Swing and a miss! Hasan Ali takes the pace off this and that does Samuels in. He's too early into the shot and ends up missing it.
FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Short one by Hasan Ali, Samuels gets a thick top edge as he makes room to pull it away. It flies over and behind and away to the fence.
Length ball in the channel outside off, Ramdin makes room and crashes the punch towards extra cover for a single.
An attempted yorker which just misses. Becomes a low full toss and Samuels has a wild swing at this. Gets a thick outside edge down to third man as a single is taken.
Length ball outside off, Samuels makes room and smashes this hard. Unfortunately for him, it's straight to the man at backward point.
Samuels steps out and flicks this full ball to the leg side for a single.
Short and wide outside off, it's slapped to the off side. One run taken.
Curving in on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, it's guided down to short third man for a quick run. A throw is in at the keeper's end but the batsman is well in by then.
Fuller outside off, it's driven to deep cover for one run.
NAWAZ is back on.
Length delivery, tucked on the leg side.

DROPPED! Full outside off, Samules hits it over covers. Asad Shafiq in the deep tries to get under it but misjudges it in the night sky and pays the price. There's another drop in the field by Pakistan. Meanwhile, the batsmen pick up a couple of runs.
WILD SWING BY SAMUELS! Short delivery wide outside off, Samuels just swings his bat wildly and misses the ball by a mile.
DENSH RAMDIN walks in at No.4!

OUT! MAGNIFICENT PIECE OF FIELDING! Take a bow, Hasan Ali! Top, top stuff. Yorker fired in on middle and leg, Bravo just about manages to dig it out to the leg side and sets off for a single. Hasan Ali is alert to this and is off in a flash. Charges to the ball, turns around and fires in a throw at the bowler's end. Bravo is struggling at this point as the bails are off. The decision goes upstairs and the replays show that Darren Bravo is gone. Some great athleticism has done the trick for the Men in Green.
A run out decision against Bravo is referred upstairs.
Length ball aimed at the top of off stump, Marlon makes room and flat-bats it to wide mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Samuels looks to slash this away but fails to make any connection on it.
HASAN ALI comes back on.
Length delivery angling in around off, Samuels, with soft hands, taps it on the off side and scurries to the other end for a quick run.
Wide! Comes from around the wicket to Marlon, angles it down the leg side. Wide called by the umpire.
On a good length and just outside off, it's punched through to deep cover for a single.
Another bumper from Mohammad Amir, similar ball and similar result. Wise choice from the southpaw.
Banged in short and outside off, some extra bounce there which rises sharply on Bravo. He looks to pull it away but it goes over him.
Amir comes from around the wicket, bowls it fuller in length and takes the pace off it as well. Samuels picks it up early and taps it to the off side for a quick single.
Length ball tailing in on middle and off, Bravo flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Tossed up fuller outside off, driven to long off for a single.
SIX! IN THE ARC, OUTSIDE THE PARK! Tossed up outside off, Bravo stretches his arms and sends it straight down the ground and into the stands. Bravo isn't going to miss out on those.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.

Served outside leg, on a shorter side, DB looks to pull but it isn't short enough to be pulled, beats his bat and hits him on the pads. The fielding side appeals but is turned down by the umpire as the ball has pitched outside leg.
Sliding away from Bravo with pace, Bravo looks to cut it but gets beaten by the pace on it.
Served outside off, Samuels takes a couple of steps ahead and drives it through covers for a single.
Full outside off, square driven straight to Rizwan at point who fields cleanly.
Back of a length delivery around off, Samuels is onto it in a flash and pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball goes one bounce into the hands of the deep mid-wicket fielder.
Full on middle and off, driven to long on for a single.
Pitched outside off, pushed to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, tapped on the off side.
Angling down leg, tucked on the leg side for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl the next over.
This is worked into the gap in the mid-wicket area for one run.

Another run out chance! What's happening here? Samuels runs this down towards short third man and sets off for a single. He is quickly sent back by his partner. He slides in and his luck is shining today. Sarfraz accidentally knocks the bails off before he caught the ball. So, Marlon survives.
A run out decision against Samuels is referred upstairs.

Leg bye! Flatter one on the pads, it goes off Bravo's pads to square leg as he looks to pull this away. The batsmen take a run as a direct hit is made at the bowler's end. The decision goes upstairs and replays show that the batsman is well in. A run is taken.
The onfield umpire refers it upstairs for a run out appeal against Bravo.

Flatter one pitched outside off, Samuels gets a bottom edge to the off side as he looks to cut it away. The batsmen set off for a quick single. Imad Wasim charges to the ball and throws it at the keeper who is late in whipping the bails off. One run completed.
Full outside off, Samuels comes down the track and blocks.

NOT OUT! DECISION STAYS! Sliding into the pads, Samuels leans ahead looking to defend but the bat gets obstructed by the pads and is late. The ball hits him on the knee role. Wasim is confident and starts appealing. However S.Ravi the umpire thinks otherwise. Wasim tells his captain to take the review and he obliges. The ball tracker shows that the ball is just going on to clip the bails and the onfield decision stands. Samuels survives a scare.
An lbw decision against Marlon Samuels is being referred upstairs.
IMAD WASIM has been brought back!
From around the wicket, tossed up outside off, it's pushed square of the wicket.
Drfiting in on the pads, it's tucked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Straying on the pads, it's just tickled fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Fullish around off, Bravo with soft hands taps it in front of cover-point and takes off for a single. There's a throw at the striker's end but the batsman is well in by then,.
Full on the pads, defended.
Dances down and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
The ball was cleared out of the ground. So, once again, the umpires call for a new ball.
17th ODI fifty for Darren Bravo!

SIX! ONTO THE ROOF AGAIN! Bravo is dipalying his attacking shades over here. Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Bravo stands and delivers it over the roof of the stadium for another maximum. This is second time that Bravo has sent the ball over the roof and the umpire has asked once again for a new ball. With this, Bravo completes his half century.
Pitched up delivery on middle and off, Samuels eases it to long on to get off the mark with a single.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Served outside off, steered to point.
Shortish delivery, spinning in, punched off the back foot straight back.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. They pick up a singlen.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Angling in with the arm, Samuels is hit low on the pads as he tries to flick it away.
It's turned to the leg side for no run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
MARLON SAMUELS is in to bat now.

OUT! HUGE MIX-UP! That's shambolic. Horrible piece of communication between the batsmen and that spells the end for Kraigg Brathwaite. Shortish outside off, Brathwaite punches it square of the wicket on the off side towards cover-point and sets off for a single. He is howveer sent back as he runs halfway down the track. Mohammad Nawaz is the man there and he fires in a throw at the keeper's end. Kraigg is way out of the crease and has no chance to make it back when the bails are whipped off. A much needed wicket for Pakistan.
Floated on the pads, tickled to mid-wicket.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh-pad.
Drfitng into the pads, driven to mid on.

DROPPED! THE SKIPPER HAS DROPPED THAT! Tossed up again by Nawaz. Bravo sits down and goes for another biggie but ends up getting it high in the air off the toe end of the bat. Azhar Ali at extra cover, places himself under it but drops as the ball is lost in the night sky. Bravo after hitting that was in such dismay that he remained unmoved. It was also brave from Nawaz to toss it up again. Bravo has survived a scare, releiving the WI camp.

SIX! ONTO THE ROOF! Tossed up outside off, Bravo displays his strength as he clobbers it out of the park. The ball is timed so perfectly with power that it sails over the roof. The onfield umpire calls for a new ball for the next delivery.
Wide! Spinning down leg, Bravo looks to flick but gets beaten as the ball spins. The ball goes past the pads and is signaled as a wide.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Some turn there for Nawaz. Served on off, turning away, Brathwaite plays it back to the bowler.
This full ball is eased down to long on off the back foot for a single.
Flat and short outside off, it's punched to deep point for one run.
Flatter one from Shoaib Malik, it's worked to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! This should relieve some pressure. First boundary in half a dozen overs. Brathwaite steps out to this one and slogs it through square leg to beat Wahab Riaz out in the deep. Picks up a much needed boundary.
Tossed up outside leg, Kraigg sweeps it straight to the man at short fine leg.
From around the wicket, Malik with a quicker one on the pads, clipped on the leg side for nothing.
Flatter ball turning in, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Kraigg Brathwaite drives this fuller ball down to long on for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Bravo misses the clip as this ball is going down leg. No wide signalled. Maybe the ball brushed the bat. Not sure.
Full on the stumps, Bravo sweeps this away through square leg. Asad Shafiq out in the deep does well to put in a dive and keep the ball from the ropes. Keeps the batsmen to two runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Brathwaite stays back in the crease and turns it to the on side.
Quicker one on off, Kraigg taps it to covers.
Flatter outside off, a back foot punch by Bravo which sends the ball down to long off for a single.

IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE! Tossed up on the pads, Kraigg kneels down and gets a thick top edge as he goes for the sweep. It lobs over towards fine leg but there's nobody there to come under it and take the catch.
From around the wicket, Malik with a quicker one on middle and off, it's worked to the on side.
Quicker one on the stumps, it's turned to short fine leg for no run.
Gets a run this time. It's pitched around off as KB drives it down to long off for a single.
Once again it's driven to the same man at extra cover. Frustrating for the batsman.
Some turn here for Mohammad Nawaz, pitched around off as Kraigg Brathwaite drives it on the up to extra cover.
Full and pitched on off, it's pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
Comes from around the wicket, floats it up around off, it's defended solidly off the front foot.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ is into the attack now.
Served wide outside off, steered towards point. Maiden by Malik!
Tossed up around off, defended by proding forward.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bravo gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it on the off side. He takes off for a single but is sent back.
Served outside off, pushed to covers.
Leg bye! Straighter one, sliding down leg, Brathwaite looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball ricochets of the pads on the leg side for a single.
SHOAIB MALIK comes on to roll his arm.
On the pads, flicked with ease for a single through square leg to keep the strike.
Pushed to the cover region with soft hands by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, taped to point again.
Full outside off, driven straight to man at mid off.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.
Straying on the pads, nudged fine on the leg side to pick up a brace.
Down the leg side, Brathwaite looks to flick but misses and goes straight into the keeper's gloves. Sarfraz appeals from behind but the umpire suggests that it hit him on the pads.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks to evade it.
Touch shorter on leg, KB looks to flick it off his thigh pad but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.

FOUR! Length delivery on pads, Brathwaite uses the crease to full effect. He shifts across a touch and tucks it beautifully in the gap for a boundary through square leg. Spirited attempt by the fielder in the deep also can't stop it from reaching the fence.
Length delivery, angling away, Brathwaite looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! SMASHED IT! Slower back of a length delivery outside off, angling in, Bravo waits for it then smashes it with a pull through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit so hard that the ball reached the fence in a flash.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.

IN THE AIR...BUT SAFE! Short ball again, Bravo looks to pull it but he isn't in the perfect position to play this shot. The ball goes off the top edge and balloons high in the air but lands safely in the long stop region. Meanwhile, the batsmen pick up a couple.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Length delivery, angling away, Bravo prods forward in defense but gets it off the inside edge of the bat.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite looks to cut the ball on the bounce but gets beaten by the lack of bounce on it.
Pitched outside off, Bravo opens the face of his bat and steers it to third man for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery again, angling down leg, KB shuffles a touch and flicks it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped to off side with soft hands for a quick single.
Full on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Two Leg byes! Down the leg side, Bravo looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes the thigh pad on its way and runs down to fine leg, fetching them two leg byes.
Full on middle and off, KB uses his wrists and plays it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch back of a length outside off, dabbed to point.
Straying on pads, clipped off the thigh pad for a single through mid-wicket.
Pitched outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, cut to point.
Powwrplay 2 has been signalled by the umpire. This means that 4 fielders will now be allowed outside the circle.
Wahab takes the pace off it a bit and pitches it right up there, Darren picks it off his pads and flicks it to the on side.
Very full and aiming middle stump, Kraigg Brathwaite brings the wrists into play and flicks it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and angled across, Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and dabs it in front of covers.
Wide! Fuller and going down leg, wide signalled as Kraigg attempts to flick it away.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, too straight from Wahab, Darren works this towards short fine leg, takes the man on there and beats the throw at the bowler's end to complete a brisk single.
Fuller and going slightly down leg, it's clipped straight to the man at short fine leg.
Wahab comes charging in and fires in a full ball outside off, it's punched to covers. No run taken as it's straight to the fielder.
WAHAB RIAZ is brought into the bowling attack.
On middle and leg, driven to mid on for no run to end the over.
Two Wides! Full and going down leg, Bravo looks to flick this away but misses and so does the keeper. As a result, the batsmen take a run. Wide signalled as well.
Full outside off, Bravo drives this to the man at covers. Timed the ball well but was unlucky not to find the gap.
Slower one, it's tapped to short extra cover. The southpaw wants the single but is sent back by his partner.
Fractionally fullish in length and pitched outside off, Bravo leans forward and keeps it out with a straight bat.
FOUR! Poor line from Hasan Ali. He strays this on the pads and makes it very easy for Darren Bravo who tucks this fine down the leg side to send it across the fine leg fence.
Length delivery outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man for a single.
HASAN ALI is brought into the attack.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Darren Bravo leans into this one and creams the drive through the covers to pick up a boundary.

A bit of Brian Lara in that shot. Length ball outside off, some width on offer as Bravo stylishly punches this square of the wicket. The fielder at point does well to run to his right and cut the ball off.

FOUR! Good shot. Lovely way to come back from that previous delivery. Fuller in length by Amir and makes it come in on middle and leg, Bravo comes on the front foot and clips it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Bravo gets hit by the bouncer. His back flap comes off the helmet. However, he seems fine and gets on with the game.

OUCH! THAT WAS SHARP! Came out of nowhere, really. Amir comes charging in and bangs in a short one. It's sharp, well-directed and accurate and leaves Bravo in no man's land. He is struck on the helmet as he had no time to duck. The strap on the back of his helmet even came off. He's generating some real pace here, Mohammad Amir, especially on a track like this.

Amir continues from around the wicket, bowls a fuller length ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite flicks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a single. Azhar Ali is the man there. He slides in to his right, collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and the batsmen complete a single.
Once again it's nudged neatly fine down the leg side. Won't beat the fielder this time, though, but will get a single nonetheless.
Straying on the pads, Kraigg just tickles it fine down the leg side past short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fullish in length and pitched on middle, it's driven down to long on for another run.
Flatter and around off, it's punched down to long on for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, KB is caught on the pads as he tries to work it away.
Some movement in the air there, tight line as Wasim pitches it around off, it's defended from within the crease.
Over the wicket to Darren Bravo, it's bunted back in the direction of the bowler.
Coming in on middle and leg, a touch fuller in length as well, it's tucked towards the backward square leg fielder for a quick single.
Amir fires it in full and just around off, it straightens up a shade as Brathwaite brings his bat down to it. Gets a thick outside edge towards backward point and that will be a dot ball.
Angles it in to the batsman, keeps it very tight, it's worked to mid-wicket. No run taken.
FOUR! Nicely played. Brathwaite opens the face of the bat to this length delivery outside off and steers it away to the third man fence for a boundary.
From around the wicket, a full ball outside off and it's driven to covers.
Kraigg gets his front foot across to this fuller ball and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Arm ball from Imad Wasim, it's clipped to mid-wicket. Kraigg did well to bring his bat down in time to that.
Brathwaite makes room for this one and looks to smash this away. Gets an inside edge to the on side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and flat on the pads, nudged to the on side.

Amir has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite picks it off his pads and tucks it to the left of the backward square leg fielder for a run.
Angling in on middle and off, keeping it on a length here, Bravo clips this through the square leg region and takes a single.

THAT'S A PEACH! Amir bowls an excellent length delivery in the channel outside off, it just straightens a touch as Darren Bravo looks to defend. Just beats the outside edge as it thuds into Sarfraz's gloves behind.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, Brathwaite swivels across and glances this down towards fine leg for a run.
On a good length around off, Bravo gets an outside edge towards backward point as he attempts to block. A single taken.
Amir from over the wicket, angles a length ball across Kraigg Brathwaite, he cuts this late down to third man and gets a single to his name.
FOUR! DRIVEN! Tossed up outside off for the southpaw, Bravo drives it frimly off the front foot through covers for a boundary.
Brathwaite comes to the pitch of the ball and slogs but ends up inside edging it to square leg. The batsmen run through for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked on the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Arm ball again, sliding down leg, KB looks to play across the line but fails to connect. The ball hits the pads and the fielders start appealing. However, the umpire is not interested as it may have gone down leg.
Sliding down leg, with the arm, clipped off the pads on the leg side for no run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Down the leg side, Bravo again looks to flick but misses. Bravo is looking for wide but the umpires doesn't agree with him. It might have brushed something on its way.
Wide! Down the leg side, Bravo looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
DARREN BRAVO walks in at No.3.

OUT! AMIR DRAWS FIRST BLOOD! Change of angle works for him. He comes around the wicket and bowls a full delivery outside off, Charles drives it on the up towards covers but doesn't time it well. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat into the hands of Wasim at covers, who is stationed there and takes the catch with no hesitation. Amir gets the early breakthrough, puting his team on the front foot. Charles' dismal tour continues!
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut to point.
Length delivery, skidding on, Charles looks to play it on the up but gets beaten by the extra bounce.
Pitched outside off, defended on the off side.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is into the attack now.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flatter one, hit down to long on for one run.
Flat once more, attacking the stumps, it's turned to backward square leg.
Straighter on middle, punched down to mid on for a brisk single.
Flat and short on middle and off, Charles goes back and punches it to mid off.
Full on off, driven to mid off for no run.

We are back for the chase. West Indies have a mountain to climb and they will need a blazing start if they are to stand any chance of winning this match. It will be Johnson Charles and Kraigg Brathwaite to open the innings for West Indies with Imad Wasim leading the Pakistan bowling attack...
